name: SCALLOP multi-cohort meta-analysis (Koprulu 2026)
aliases: SCALLOP|Koprulu et al.|Koprulu 2026|SCALLOP Olink Target meta-analysis
cohort_components: 45 participant sources, listed in verification/dataset_components.csv; pQTL cohorts among them: INTERVAL, FENLAND, KORA, FHS
ancestry: European (meta-analysis; ARISTOTLE 95% and STABILITY 87% European descent per Table S1A); non-European cohorts CKB, QMDIAB, SWMHS used only for comparison
sample_size: up to 78,664 (UKBB 48,017; SCALLOP cohorts the remainder)
platform: Olink Target 96 (13 panels) and UKB Olink
source_citation: Koprulu M et al. 2026 Cell (Multi-cohort proteogenomic analyses reveal genetic effects across the proteome and diseasome)
source_read: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC13343581/fullTextXML (Summary; Results: Multi-cohort genome-proteome-wide pQTL discovery; STAR Methods: participant details, proteomic measurements, meta-analysis, non-European comparison; Data and code availability); https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC13343581/supplementaryFiles -> NIHMS2173841-supplement-MMC1.xlsx (Table S1A all rows, Table S1B all rows)
notes: Table S1A ('cohort characteristics of SCALLOP cohorts included in this study') lists 41 analysis rows that collapse to the IDs above; Methods say 'up to 37 cohorts (Table S1)' plus UKBB, abstract says 38 studies. The 41 rows include four obvious split pairs (BAMSE W1/W2, EPIC cases/controls, PROCARDIS cases/controls, SWEBIC lah1/swe6), which gives 37, but the paper does not state the mapping (DIRECT diabetes/prediabetics and RS/RS3 are also split rows). No cohort outside Table S1A is described as contributing pQTL summary statistics. Per-panel participation varies (panels in as_written). Iceland 'no': no Icelandic cohort in Table S1A; Dan-NICAD acknowledgement says 'Genotyping was performed by deCODE genetics' (genotyping service for a Danish sample, not Icelandic participants). New IDs: IBD1000, ARISTOTLE, ASAP, BAMSE, COSMC, DANNICAD, MANOLIS/POMAK (existing IDs reused for HELIC), KARMA, DIRECT source cohorts (METSIM, HOORN_MEAL_STUDY, NEW_HOORN_STUDY, HEALTH2010, HEALTH2006, DANFUND, GGG), MUTOGRAPHS, SAHLSIS, PROCARDIS, BELOVE, RISC. DIRECT is a consortium; its rows are kept and its named source cohorts listed because Table S1A names them as the sources of DIRECT participants (which of them contributed to the Olink subset is not stated). MDC enters only through DIRECT; RISC appears both as its own row and as a DIRECT source. SWEBIC lah1/swe6 mapped to existing ID STANLEY: Table S1B says SWEBIC was funded by the Stanley Center, and the dictionary's Zhao 2023 row lists the same splits as 'STANLEY-swe6; STANLEY-lahl'. KORA row is KORA F4. EPIC centre is not stated (IO panel; cases and controls). SAHLSIS controls come from unnamed population-based cohorts or registers. IMPROVE (a SCALLOP CVD-I cohort) is not in Table S1A. The dictionary's existing component string 'SCALLOP|UKB' should be replaced by the list here. SWEBIC and STANLEY are kept as separate components (registered decision); whether STANLEY is SWEBIC is unconfirmed.
